tips.title: Follow the 50/30/20 Rule
tips.content: Allocate 50% of income to needs, 30% to wants, and 20% to savings and debt repayment.

tips.title: Track Small Expenses
tips.content: Small daily purchases add up quickly. Monitor them to identify unnecessary spending patterns.

tips.title: Set Clear Financial Goals
tips.content: Define specific, measurable financial goals with deadlines to stay motivated.

tips.title: Build an Emergency Fund
tips.content: Aim to save 3-6 months of expenses for unexpected situations.

tips.title: Wait Before Big Purchases
tips.content: Implement a 24-48 hour waiting period for non-essential purchases to avoid impulse buying.
